settings.name: runtime
settings.description: Generate 100 tokens with Qwen3-8B on one RTX Pro 6000; input contexts 8k-64k; compression ratios 0.6 and 0.8.

data.correctness: Jacap is a lossy KV-cache eviction method: discarded states can change model outputs, so equivalence to the uncompressed model is not guaranteed. Quality is measured on LongBench, NIAH, and AIME25. No retraining is required.
data.methodology: Three long-context model architectures are compared on LongBench, sparse long-range retrieval is stressed with NIAH, dynamic decode-time eviction is tested with AIME25, and Appendix C measures runtime overhead. Query statistics are estimated from historical decoding queries; diagonal covariance is used in practice.
data.scope: Evidence supports retention quality under KV compression rather than a complete serving-system speedup claim. Runtime is described as comparable to mainstream baselines, but exact Figure 5 timings are not tabulated in the HTML text. Theoretical per-layer/eviction complexity is O(N d_h^2 + d_h^3).
